text:
maria: FYI we keep losing the context of why a request was tied into a particular batch when it reaches the model runtime. that makes it hard to explain transient GPU spikes. can we design a tiny, low-cardinality visibility layer that survives proxies and fanout?
aj: we need to be careful about cardinality. what minimal fields would help diagnostics and cost rollups?
simon: minimal set: batch_id (trace-only), batch_mode (latency|throughput|fallback), batch_hint_size, and an exec_tag (int8|fp16|fp32). put batch_id on spans and logs, but never on metric labels.
maria: agreed. metrics: rw.batch.choice{mode,model,route,exec_tag}.count + rw.batch.estimated_compute_ms{model,route,exec_tag}.sum. keep labels low-card. batch_id only in traces/logs.
nina: sampling: capture 100% of batch decisions (we need that eventstream). capture token-level deltas only as sampled diagnostics (default 0.5%). scrub any user content. add per-route overrides so high-volume internal routes can be tuned.
kevin: storage tradeoffs: indexing batch_id is expensive — index only traces marked diagnostic=true and keep that short TTL (48-72h). also produce a daily rollup table keyed by model/route/mode/exec_tag to answer cost questions without trace joins.
aj: implementation plan: edge sidecar will inject headers X-RW-BATCH-ID, X-RW-BATCH-MODE, X-RW-BATCH-HINT, X-RW-EXEC-TAG. runtime will read and attach to root span attributes (rw.batch_id, rw.batch_mode, rw.batch_hint, rw.exec_tag) and the response logger will emit the batch footprint.
simon: pseudocode for edge shim:
```
batch = batcher.decide(req)
req.h.set("X-RW-BATCH-ID", batch.id)
req.h.set("X-RW-BATCH-MODE", batch.mode)
req.h.set("X-RW-BATCH-HINT", str(batch.hint))
req.h.set("X-RW-EXEC-TAG", batch.exec_tag)
metric.emit("rw.batch.choice", 1, {mode:batch.mode, model:req.model, route:req.route, exec_tag:batch.exec_tag})
if rand() < route_cfg.token_delta_sample: emit_event("rw.token.delta", scrub(sample))
```
nina: privacy: token samples must pass through pii-scrubber and should default to counts and hashed fingerprints. provide a config observable.ingress.batch_visibility.enabled: hosted=true, private=false. also add a route-level allowlist for emitting exec_tag.
kevin: rollup schema sketch: batch_rollup_{day} with columns date, model, route, mode, exec_tag, total_batches, avg_batch_size, est_gpu_ms. retention 90 days. diagnostic traces with batch_id indexed for 72h when sample_for_diag=true.
maria: rollout steps: 1) RFC with header contract + sample schemas (aj) 2) edge shim prototype in staging (simon + aj) 3) scrubber + sampling knobs (nina) 4) rollup job + dashboard tile (kevin) 5) defaults/docs and private opt-out (maria). target: 2 sprints for prototype.
aj: will open RFC today and include compact proto examples and config knobs.
simon: starting branch for the shim. leaving thread open for feedback. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: scheduled canary deploy edge-sidecar v4.2 -> staging at 4032109900 :rocket:
